narr: A cold front triggered bands of strong to severe thunderstorms across west-central Illinois during the evening of June 25th. Some of the cells produced wind gusts up to 60mph, resulting in scattered wind damage. In addition, excessive rainfall rates led to localized flash flooding with some of the stronger storms.
ev: Several streets were flooded in Normal.
The South Fork of the Sangamon River spilled out of its banks and flowed across Route 104 just east of Kincaid.
Water was flowing across Davis Road northeast of Pawnee.
lsr: STREET FLOODING REPORTED. RELAYED BY MEDIA.
